name: poupamais-development
description: Ambiente integrado do PoupaMais: Docker Compose (dev, como produção e E2E), Nginx e painel de desenvolvimento

scripts.dev: docker compose up -d --build --wait --wait-timeout 600 && node scripts/enderecos.js dev
scripts.dev:reset: docker compose down -v --remove-orphans && docker compose up -d --build --wait --wait-timeout 600 --renew-anon-volumes && node scripts/enderecos.js dev
scripts.prod: npm run certs && docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.prod.yml up -d --build --wait --wait-timeout 900 && node scripts/enderecos.js prod
scripts.prod:reset: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.prod.yml down -v --remove-orphans && npm run prod
scripts.status: docker compose ls -a --filter name=poupamais && docker compose ps -a && docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.prod.yml ps -a
scripts.e2e:up: docker compose -f docker-compose.e2e.yml up -d --build --wait --wait-timeout 600 && node scripts/enderecos.js e2e
scripts.e2e:reset: docker compose -f docker-compose.e2e.yml down -v && npm run e2e:up
scripts.check: node --check config/painel/server.js && node --check config/painel/public/app.js && node --check scripts/conferir-portas.js && node --check scripts/enderecos.js
